title: The Track in the Snow
text: The quarry's tracks lie clear as print in fresh snow, leading straight and steady away from you. They are too clear, too easy. The quarry is clever, and it knows it is being hunted.

options.label: Follow the tracks, trusting that easy is sometimes just easy.

outcomes.text: They lead into its trap, exactly as it meant.

options.label: The sharpest reads the tracks to learn why they are so clear.

outcomes.text: It walked them backward. It is behind you.

options.label: Wait for it to come to you; let the hunter be hunted.

outcomes.text: It comes in its own time. The waiting is the worst of it.
